monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral ventilation-fan decision system covering airflow job, installed restriction, fan-curve evidence, authorized controls, environment, electrical and mounting gates, recall checks, acceptance testing, and first-year cost. It adds no merchant, model, price, coupon, ranking, availability claim, fabricated test, product image, or paid placement and preserves professional-review and no-purchase outcomes.

image_qa.note: Both new guides use text, evidence tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No person, headache, cannabis product, fan, controller, duct, filter, merchant, affiliate, stock image, or generated image was added. The existing brand image file was not altered; only its context-specific loading semantics changed, so no exact-product mismatch or new licensing issue was introduced.

search_console.decision: The October 5–November 1 report showed 786 impressions, four clicks, 0.509% CTR, and average position 24.632. ‘510 vs disposable’ had two impressions at position 12, while Delaware, federal-property, and Montana signals had one impression or click apiece; those samples were too weak to redirect the portfolio and existing pages already serve those intents. Blue Dream had 18 impressions near position 45 and was also too weak and off the target 4–20 range for another strain variation. No item is primarily Data-led. The report acted as a cannibalization guard while the batch fills distinct migraine-evidence, lawful-home-grow equipment, and site-delivery gaps.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy cannabis-and-migraine evidence guide anchored by the 2026 randomized crossover trial, a current randomized-trial systematic review, NCCIH, FDA, and MedlinePlus. Its result ledger, six transfer checks, emergency boundary, claim screen, and clinician handoff strengthen the chronic-pain, medicine-interaction, clinician-conversation, and driving-safety paths through reciprocal contextual links. No tightly matched unsolicited outreach target was strong enough to log, and no outreach was sent.
